description: The plot illustrates the relationship between epochs and BLEU score for three different member sets. The x-axis is labeled “Epochs” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 3.0, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score” with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. A blue solid line represents “Regular members,” starting at approximately 0.03 at an epoch of 0.0 and ending at approximately 0.13 at an epoch of 3.0, with a slight peak at around 0.14 at an epoch of 2.5. An orange solid line represents “Members with near-duplicates,” beginning at approximately 0.03 at an epoch of 0.0 and rising to approximately 0.32 at an epoch of 3.0, with a peak at approximately 0.33 at an epoch of 2.0. A green solid line represents “Held-out data,” starting at approximately 0.02 at an epoch of 0.0 and ending at approximately 0.06 at an epoch of 3.0, with a slight peak at around 0.07 at an epoch of 1.5.
